title: Quick to heat, careful of exposed iron.
text: Quick to heat, careful of exposed iron.. We used it to lightly roast spices, raw nuts. It does heat up quickly..so don’t touch the exposed iron.  The rubber handle does help, but being such a small pan, it was challenging not to touch the iron/exposed handle.  Eggs were quick to cook, and no sticking so far.  Cleaning is with soft side, as these non stick elements can be ‘cleaned’ off.

product_metadata.title: Ecolution Ceramic Non-Stick Fry Mini Egg Pan, Easy to Clean, Silicone Handle, 5.5 Inch, Gunmetal/Gray
features: VERSATILE MINIATURE PAN- cook the perfect single egg or melt some delicious garlic butter with this versatile mini fry pan.
EASY TO CLEAN- This aluminum mini fry pan is easy to clean thanks to the non-stick coating that offers incredible food release, allowing you to save time on clean up in the kitchen between uses.
EVEN HEATING- the aluminum construction is heavy gauge for even heating across the surface of the pan so you can evenly cook your entire meal on one surface.
PREMIUM NON-STICK COATING- cooking and cleaning is a breeze with the ceramic non-stick coating. Food slides right off and onto your plate and makes clean up quick and easy.
EASY TO USE- the comfortable grip silicone handle makes it easy to move this little pan from stovetop to counter.
MINI SPATULA INCLUDED- The included mini spatula is safe for use on non-stick surfaces and is the perfect size to use with this mini frying pan.
description: Ecolution Cookware features Hydrolon - our ecologically advanced water-based nonstick coating Made without PFOA Hydrolon emits no greenhouse gasses making cooking safer for you and the environment These are miniature sizes of popular pans in bright cheerful colors Featuring comfortable-to-grip silicone handles the pans are oven-safe up to 350 degrees and dishwasher safe Since the pans are made of pure aluminum consistent heating is and even heating is equal to happy eating
